title: BRANCH B Santo後の連合艦隊作戦意思・New Caledonia前段 v011
core_thesis: Use Santo as an air/search/fleet-staging anvil and New Caledonia as both territorial objective and favorable fleet-battle forcing mechanism.
priority_order: repair/regenerate carriers, air groups and damaged surface ships
suppress but do not occupy Efate
shape U.S. movement toward New Caledonia
reassess and normally stop before Fiji/Samoa
key_lessons: carrier mission kill does not remove an air group if land recovery fields remain
SG fast battleships are independent operational threats
Type 93 waves shape enemy maneuver even without hits
land bases should free carrier decks for fleet strike/CAP
experienced aircrew are a campaign resource, not expendable replacements

preferred_nc_architecture.heavy_main_body: desired as distant reserve if U.S. fast-battleship concentration and tanker geometry justify it

fiji_samoa_policy: not automatic; normally postponed after New Caledonia
